resources.string: Touch and hold anywhere on the screen for a while to simulate a press.
Set up a keyboard shortcut in %1$s › %2$s, or add an item in %3$s › %4$s and choose it from the Quick Input menu, to send a custom sequence of keys and text to the connected device.
Native touch is supported when you connect with Apple VNC to a Mac with macOS 27.3 or later.
When you connect with Apple VNC to a Mac with macOS 27.3 or later, you can turn on %1$s › %2$s.
